name: Andrographis
short: Serious adverse events were very rare in trials; non-serious ones, mostly gut and skin complaints, were common. Spontaneous reports include allergic reactions such as anaphylaxis and angioedema.
text: In a meta-analysis of 10 randomised trials and 3 intensive monitoring studies of oral andrographis, serious adverse events were very rare (pooled 0.02 per 1000 patients) while non-serious ones were very common (about 103 per 1000 patients in trials), mostly gastrointestinal and skin complaints. Thailand's national pharmacovigilance database, which includes spontaneous reports, held 106 hypersensitivity reports with andrographis as the only suspected product, 13 of them anaphylactic shock, anaphylactic reaction or angioedema, with onset from 5 minutes to 1 day. In a 44-person trial of the constituent andrographolide, the adverse events related to treatment were mild rash and dysgeusia (taste disturbance). No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
